0022600190.text: The Hawks (6-4, third straight win, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) host the Nets (2-6, on a one-game win streak, 5th in the Atlantic, 13th in the East). Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Asa Newell (toe) and Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), with Noah Clowney (illness) day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Hawks won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 141-107 in Brooklyn on April 3, and the teams have not met yet this season.
